name: worktrees
description: Start branches, read CI, rebase onto the head branch, describe, ship and merge pull requests, and prune finished worktrees through the worktrees CLI

interface.shortDescription: Branches, CI, rebases, pull requests and cleanup, through one CLI
interface.longDescription: Start a branch from the freshly fetched head branch, read a pull request's checks as compact JSON, keep its title and description true to its diff, and merge it once CI is green, reporting what was fixed on the way, or ship a change from uncommitted work to a merged pull request without being asked along the way. Rebase the branch you are on onto the head branch, resolving each conflict the rebase stops at, and remove the worktrees and branches the worktrees CLI proves finished, after asking.
capabilities: Read a pull request's CI checks as JSON, and wait for them
Check and correct a pull request's title and description
Fix failing checks, then merge with the repository's strategy
Ship a change from uncommitted work to a merged pull request, unassisted
Start branches from the freshly fetched head branch
Rebase this branch onto the head branch and resolve its conflicts
Remove only the finished worktrees and branches you choose
defaultPrompt: Did CI pass on this pull request?
Merge pull request 42 once it is green.
Bring this branch up to date with main.
Clean up the finished worktrees and branches here.
